values.note: $32 a night at the three back-in sites, $36 at the pull-throughs ($224 / $252 a week); the same on a Saturday and in November 2026 and June 2027.

note: Wooded campground north of the covered bridge and the South Fork River shoals; the equestrian campground is separate. Enter from Hwy 22: the covered bridge has a 9-ft clearance and 3-ton limit, so do NOT route an RV over it. --Claude
summary: Georgia State Parks still book on ReserveAmerica (gastateparks.reserveamerica.com; every Reserve link on gastateparks.org goes there). Confirmed 21 RV sites, phone 706-783-5349, $32-36, showers/dump, open year round. Added water + electric (50 A at 3 sites, 30 A elsewhere), max 50 ft (all 21 fit 23 ft), 18 pull-throughs, the RA deep link. Park page: 'Overnight guests pay daily ParkPass fee only once per vehicle during their stay' - left to the inherited agency entrance row. Covered-bridge notice confirmed verbatim on the park page ('regular RV campers should enter from Highway 22'); kept in the note. Not waterfront confirmed: imagery shows the campground loop in woods ~250 m north of the river at the bridge. Pin is on the loop. Note trimmed of counts/hookups/facilities/booking.
